description: Aimparency should run as a service on the user's computer with a browser UI and connect to local projects that contain a .bowman directory. The core product is open source and local-first, not a hosted commercial service.
reflection: Reconciled this strategy container: it is not open implementation work. Its architecture child is human-dependent and its publishability child is 4/5 complete with the same remaining clean-clone validation. Keep the long-standing strategy intent, but surface the actual human verification gate.

supportingConnections.hypothesis: Real outside use is the only authoritative signal that the local-first open-source strategy works.

status.comment: The local-first architecture and release preparation are implemented; both branches now wait on a real-machine clean-clone/first-run test and human acceptance.
